fields.q: 我真不知道该拿对媞雅拉的这份感情怎么办。
fields.en: I just don't know what to do about these feelings I have for Tialla.
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 我真不知道该拿对媞雅拉的这份感情怎么办。

en.value: I just don't know what to do about these feelings I have for Tialla.

fields.q: 大家都在战斗。虽然害怕，但我会尽力的！
fields.en: Everyone's fighting. It's scary, but I'm doing my best!
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 大家都在战斗。虽然害怕，但我会尽力的！

en.value: Everyone's fighting. It's scary, but I'm doing my best!

fields.q: 怕到腿发抖、动都动不了的时候，该怎么办？
fields.en: What should I do when I get so scared my legs start shaking and I can't move?
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 怕到腿发抖、动都动不了的时候，该怎么办？

en.value: What should I do when I get so scared my legs start shaking and I can't move?

fields.q: 有些动物总是吵吵闹闹的。你不会那样吧？
fields.en: Some animals make all kinds of racket. But you don't do that, do you?
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 有些动物总是吵吵闹闹的。你不会那样吧？

en.value: Some animals make all kinds of racket. But you don't do that, do you?

fields.q: 附近有棵金吉树。我们一起去摘果子吧！
fields.en: There's a ginji tree not far from here. We should go together and pick some of the fruit!
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 附近有棵金吉树。我们一起去摘果子吧！

en.value: There's a ginji tree not far from here. We should go together and pick some of the fruit!

fields.q: 我梦见了一只美丽的鸟……不知道是不是你的朋友。
fields.en: I had a dream about a beautiful bird… I wonder if it was a friend of yours.
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 我梦见了一只美丽的鸟……不知道是不是你的朋友。

en.value: I had a dream about a beautiful bird… I wonder if it was a friend of yours.

fields.q: 我喜欢云。它们好大，能变出各种形状，好有意思。
fields.en: I like clouds. They're so big, and it's neat to see all the shapes they can take.
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 我喜欢云。它们好大，能变出各种形状，好有意思。

en.value: I like clouds. They're so big, and it's neat to see all the shapes they can take.

fields.q: 一放松就想睡……喂，我要是睡着了，你会叫醒我吗？
fields.en: Taking it easy makes me sleepy… Hey, if I fall asleep, will you wake me up?
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 一放松就想睡……喂，我要是睡着了，你会叫醒我吗？

en.value: Taking it easy makes me sleepy… Hey, if I fall asleep, will you wake me up?

fields.q: 在森林里散步，听着各种动物的叫声，很舒服吧？
fields.en: It's nice to walk around the forest and listen to all the sounds the animals make, huh?
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 在森林里散步，听着各种动物的叫声，很舒服吧？

en.value: It's nice to walk around the forest and listen to all the sounds the animals make, huh?

fields.q: 看着你……就觉得人生再难的事我也能面对。
fields.en: I look at you and… You make me feel like I can face even the most difficult things in life.
fields.name: 皮特鲁

q.value: 看着你……就觉得人生再难的事我也能面对。

en.value: I look at you and… You make me feel like I can face even the most difficult things in life.
